interpretation: Same source query token cache contains tiny non-identical row vectors for identical text. The resulting query-only per-row classifier can rank same-text rows above chance (C1 is 0.883) without video input. Treat query-only pooled AUROC as a prior diagnostic, but treat query-only same-query PairAcc as invalid until a deterministic one-vector-per-text feature control is introduced. This does not invalidate the main video model same-query PairAcc because that includes video, but it is a caution for Q-only attribution.
scope: inner Novel-dev repeated exact normalized text
